hero.title: A Spanish virtual number for SMS verification
intro: Spain runs on WhatsApp: from family group chats to booking a table, the green icon is where Spanish life gets arranged. Add one of Europe's liveliest Instagram scenes and a national devotion to AliExpress bargains, and a +34 number becomes the natural key to the Spanish internet.

SMS Code gives you a real Spanish mobile number in one tap. Enter it at the verification step, and the SMS — with a code from WhatsApp, Instagram, Tinder, AliExpress or Airbnb — appears in the app usually within seconds.

whyCountry.title: Why choose a Spanish number?
body: A +34 number is what you reach for when an account should belong to the Spanish market: a WhatsApp profile Spanish contacts will recognize as local, a Tinder presence in Madrid or Barcelona, an Airbnb account for hosting or traveling within Spain. Few places in Europe are as attached to AliExpress as Spain, and a local number keeps that shopping account close to home too.

Spanish mobile numbers begin with a 6 — or, in newer ranges, a 7 — after the +34 code, nine digits in total. It's a clean EU format that services across Europe and worldwide validate without a second glance.

tips.title: 6 and 7 both mean mobile
tips.body: In Spain's numbering plan, mobiles historically start with 6, and ranges starting with 7 were added later as demand grew. Either prefix is a normal Spanish mobile — services treat them identically at verification.

tips.title: WhatsApp is how Spain says hello
tips.body: For a Spanish-market account, WhatsApp comes first — it's the country's default channel for everything from friends to businesses. Verify it with your +34 number before building out the rest.

tips.title: Don't wait on a silent number
tips.body: If the verification SMS hasn't landed within the activation window, cancel the activation — an activation with no SMS costs nothing — and take another Spanish number for a clean retry.

faqs.q: Is it a real Spanish mobile number?
faqs.a: Yes — a number on a real carrier network in the standard +34 format, starting with a mobile prefix. Services see an ordinary Spanish mobile subscriber.

faqs.q: Which services do people verify with a +34 number?
faqs.a: WhatsApp leads — it's the center of Spanish digital life — followed by Instagram, Tinder, AliExpress and Airbnb, all deeply established in the Spanish market.

faqs.q: Does a Spanish number help with AliExpress?
faqs.a: Spain is one of AliExpress's strongest European markets, so its flows handle +34 numbers constantly. A Spanish number fits naturally with an account oriented toward Spanish delivery and deals.

faqs.q: Can I use a Spanish number without being in Spain?
faqs.a: Yes. The number lives in the SMS Code app, so the verification code reaches you anywhere — no Spanish SIM, no roaming, no location requirement.

faqs.q: What happens if I want to keep the account long-term?
faqs.a: The number is rented for the activation window, which covers receiving the code. Right after signing up, attach a recovery email and enable authenticator-app 2FA so the account stands on its own.
